suffrāgium

suffrāgium, suffrāgiī n.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

a vote; the right to vote

In this lexicon

  • vote

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 11.27.7: ego tē suffrāgium tulisse in illā lēge prīmum nōn crēdidī; Traupman 181: suffrāgium ferō, vote; M-O s.v. vote vb.; vote: ballot; Traupman 178, 402
